huggingface.summary: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. huggingface.title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
